changes: Added a manual update checker for installed modules in the admin interface
Added a server update guide and integrated it into the update mechanism
Added documentation describing the planned migration of Ministra into a standalone module
Improved PortalHandler module resolution and missing module error reporting
Enhanced LINE_CREATE_FAIL diagnostics by exposing underlying database errors
Improved reseller processing by safely handling optional POST fields and package output formats
Fixed file cache creation when temporary cache directories are owned by root
Improved network detection by handling invalid cached network data
Hardened admin views against undefined array access and null values
Improved TMDB stability with null-safe entity handling and duplicate library protection
Improved Player API and streaming stability through additional null-safety and cache validation
Automatically create image cache directories when required
Improved cron cleanup logic for connection directories
Updated diagnostics log submission to use the correct HTTPS endpoint
Forced browser cache refresh for JavaScript and CSS assets after updates
Removed obsolete Watch and Plex authentication code and cleaned up legacy components
Improved TMDB title normalization and simplified architecture tests
Continued stability, diagnostics, and maintainability improvements across the platform
